campaign.name: NarcoGuard Rev 5 Development
campaign.note: Goal is a planning budget, not a supplier quote or promise to manufacture a fixed number of watches.

messaging.tagline: Help build NarcoGuard: free recovery help now, responsible wearable R&D next
messaging.mission: Free person-led overdose prevention and recovery support, plus transparent wearable research
messaging.callToAction: Support Rev 5 prototype engineering, validation, and continued free access to NarcoGuard
messaging.truthBoundary: The app is live; the watch is a research concept and not a validated medical device.

rev5.camera: off-by-default privacy-controlled camera with mechanical shutter, hardware power gate, and power-linked indicator
rev5.heroNetwork: community responder/resource architecture that supplements rather than replaces 911
